name: Caveman
tagline: Viral agent skill and proxy that cuts tokens by making coding agents talk like a caveman
description: Caveman is a skill and proxy for coding agents that makes them say and read less. The project reports 33.2 percent fewer input tokens through the proxy, and 18 of 18 correct answers across 54 Claude Code runs. It also offers a compact browse mode for web pages. It ships an npm CLI, middleware, and an SDK, uses the Apache 2.0 license, and has more than 110,000 GitHub stars.
agent_guidance: Use it to cut token costs on long agent sessions. Keep the full style for user-facing text, because the terse output is for the agent, not the reader.
why_it_matters: It shows how much an output style changes agent cost.
